Hi Zoe — thanks for the details. We can perform a targeted removal of a single conversation, scoped to your US region, without touching unrelated records. To proceed we need 3 pieces:

- The exact message id(s) or conversation id (please confirm the internal id from your export; the attached request file helps)

- Confirmation you approve the standard audit response: we will delete the conversation payloads and redact conversational content from telemetry; we will keep a tamper-evident tombstone and workflow record for our internal audit (no PII content in the retained tombstone).

Estimated turnaround once we have the items above: 48-72 business hours (can expedite to 24 hours with a legal POA).

I attached a template attestation form and a checklist for the scoped removal.
